title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Shares Bought by Macroview Investment Management LLC
text:
Posted by Nicole Wilson
Macroview Investment Management LLC lifted its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 220.3% during the first quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 619 shares during the period. Apple makes up approximately 0.5% of Macroview Investment Management LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 21st biggest holding. Macroview Investment Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $151,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also made changes to their positions in the company. Colorado Capital Management Inc. lifted its holdings in Apple by 7.7% during the fourth quarter. Colorado Capital Management Inc. now owns 10,193 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,725,000 after purchasing an additional 733 shares in the last quarter. Stonehearth Capital Management LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 19.1% in the fourth quarter. Stonehearth Capital Management LLC now owns 3,066 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $519,000 after buying an additional 491 shares during the last quarter. Starfire Investment Advisers Inc. raised its position in shares of Apple by 103.7% in the fourth quarter. Starfire Investment Advisers Inc. now owns 7,299 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,235,000 after buying an additional 3,715 shares during the last quarter. Ayalon Holdings Ltd. acquired a new stake in shares of Apple in the fourth quarter valued at about $538,000. Finally, Atria Investments LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 4.3% in the fourth quarter. Atria Investments LLC now owns 107,301 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $18,159,000 after buying an additional 4,427 shares during the last quarter. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 58.08% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
Apple opened at $190.98 on Friday, Marketbeat reports. Apple Inc. has a 12-month low of $148.13 and a 12-month high of $195.96. The stock has a market cap of $988.52 billion, a P/E ratio of 20.74, a PEG ratio of 1.57 and a beta of 1.24. The company has a quick ratio of 1.37, a current ratio of 1.46 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. The firm had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $60.94 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. Apple’s revenue was up 15.6% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same period last year, the business earned $2.10 earnings per share. equities research analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.42 earnings per share for the current year.
Apple declared that its Board of Directors has authorized a stock buyback program on Tuesday, May 1st that authorizes the company to buyback $100.00 billion in shares. This buyback authorization authorizes the iPhone maker to reacquire up to 11.9% of its shares through open market purchases. Shares buyback programs are usually an indication that the company’s board of directors believes its stock is undervalued.
A number of equities research analysts have recently commented on the stock. BMO Capital Markets increased their target price on shares of Apple from $171.00 to $184.00 and gave the company a “market perform” rating in a research report on Monday, July 23rd. Atlantic Securities reiterated a “neutral” rating and issued a $185.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, May 2nd. Goldman Sachs Group set a $164.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research report on Friday, July 20th. Barclays increased their target price on shares of Apple from $157.00 to $161.00 and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a research report on Wednesday, May 2nd. Finally, Zacks Investment Research upgraded shares of Apple from a “sell” rating to a “hold” rating in a research report on Thursday, May 3rd. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, fifteen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and two have given a strong buy rating to the stock. The company currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $209.47.
In other Apple news, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 15,653 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Tuesday, May 8th. The shares were sold at an average price of $185.18, for a total transaction of $2,898,622.54. Following the completion of the transaction, the chief operating officer now owns 168,181 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $31,143,757.58. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available at this link . Also, insider Angela J. Ahrendts sold 38,228 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Friday, May 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $176.54, for a total transaction of $6,748,771.12. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 90,967 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $16,059,314.18. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last ninety days, insiders have sold 168,738 shares of company stock valued at $31,247,951. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by insiders.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
